title: Hike though the rocks and mud
text: Expect a medium to hard hike in the beautiful Antequerra mountain. It was a beautiful day but muddy after the rain so get ready. Our guide was very quiet but courteous. He didn’t say much but I guess you can’t really talk too much during the hike. It would add more if more historical background story was added. But overall it was a great experience. I recommend it if to love outdoors and if you have done all the other important historical tours.
author: Meehae_J
